scope: Whole unsigned64 1/3/5/9-byte writer plus actual byte-vector growth/layout adapter; selected real caller context.

qualification.observations: Actual Vec capacity, initialized length, alloc/realloc request count and every initialized byte.

allocator_controls: Probe wraps actual System GlobalAlloc, forwarding successful allocations/reallocations/deallocations. Selected requests return null only while the independently authored library call is armed. Actual Vec::try_reserve handles refusal; no mock Vec, target execution or resource-exhaustion claim.

selection: Live open PR inventory had no varint buffer writer/5822910 implementation. Existing varint-size-state code is a counter, not byte writing. Actual selected caller 4e09fe0 provides two confirmed calls. Root rechecks live before publication.
analysis_limits: Adjacent function addresses were initially considered width-family leads, then complete disassembly showed higher-level serializers; no such unsupported type was implemented.
Preliminary relative-call byte candidates lacking a complete containing FDE were retained as unconfirmed work/xrefs data, never promoted into a caller census.
limits: Native allocator identity/backend state, pointer/Result ABI, fatal/panic continuation and enclosing serializer schema remain unclosed. Failure enum is a safe boundary snapshot. No captured execution/emulation, allocator byte equality or component gate change.
